title: Fear of Feminism
author: Sarah Palmisciano
description: This podcast is not only dedicated to my experience growing up from being a middle school girl who wanted to fit it, to now being an unexperienced feminist with good intentions. It is also meant to understand what makes an individual scared to call themselves a feminist. I discuss my own personal relationship with feminism as well as the relationship my family members have to feminism. I hope you can relate to some of these fears and enjoy the podcast!
